name: 46052 · Lebanon, IN
findings: ZIP 46052 (Lebanon) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 39 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46052 (Lebanon) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46052 (Lebanon) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.8 times the typical level).
